Some verses routed A and B were also used for their human side, where they belong to the same account: Gen 11:6; Pro 16:9; Isa 8:10; Act 5:38; Gen 50:20; 1Ch 28:9; 29:18; Isa 26:3; 1Co 4:5.

lines.text: | **10.7 Choosing and setting direction**, new section ***Planning*** | The account of looking ahead. Planning carries a choice ahead (Gen 11:6; Pro 16:9). It covers: weighing first (Luk 14:28–33; Pro 31:15–16; Judg 19:30); planning without knowing (Act 27:10–14, 39–41; Rom 1:13; Jam 4:15); a plan carrying a person's word (2Co 1:17–18); planning together and parting (Act 15:37–39; Luk 23:51–52); planning for another's good (Dan 6:3–4), with the king's planning measured against God's (2Sa 14:13–14); a purpose held (Psa 17:3, 5; Act 11:23; 2Ti 3:10; 1Ch 29:18; Rom 8:6–7; Isa 26:3); devised from one's own heart (1Ki 12:32–33; Neh 6:8); the plan and its outcome (Pro 16:9; Isa 8:10; Act 5:38–39; Psa 21:11; Dan 11:24; Gen 50:20); seen and disclosed (1Ch 28:9; 1Co 4:3–5) | New section |
| 10.7 *Holding a choice* | A bullet: a purpose set ahead (Psa 17:3), pointing to *Planning* | Widened |

| **10.10 Relating to others**, new section ***Plotting against another*** | Planned in the heart (Psa 140:2; Zec 7:10; 8:17). Done together (Psa 31:13; Jer 48:2; Joh 11:53; 12:10–11; Eze 11:2; Dan 11:25, 27; Jer 49:30). Aimed at the quiet and the weak (Psa 10:2; 35:20; 37:12; Eze 38:10–11). Hidden behind something friendly (Neh 6:2–3; 1Sa 18:25). Accusing the other of a plan (Neh 6:6, 8–9). The one plotted against: not knowing (Jer 11:19–20); praying to be guarded (Psa 140:4, 8; 35:4); trusting (Psa 31:14–15); another pleading (Est 8:3; 9:24); another stopping it (Act 27:42–43). Named and checked (Pro 24:8–9; 30:32–33; Deu 19:19–20) | New section |

| **10.4 Thinking** | *Where thoughts come from*: Eze 38:10 (the thought arrives, then the devising). *It designs*: Huram-abi (2Ch 2:14). *It reckons*: Gen 31:15; Lam 4:2; Isa 33:8; 13:17–18; being reckoned (Psa 44:22; 88:3–4; Num 23:9; Neh 13:13). *What is devised comes back*: Deu 19:19. Connections: planning (10.7) and plotting (10.10) | Widened |
| **10.9 Relating to God** | Plotting turned against him (Hos 7:14–15; Nah 1:9, 11). His word reckoned strange, and his name esteemed (Hos 8:12; Mal 3:16). A pointer to 13.1 *Purposing* | Widened |
| **10.11 Hiding and disclosing**, *The hidden trap* | The friendly word as cover (Neh 6:2), not knowing (Jer 11:19), the trap hidden (Psa 140:5) | Widened |
| **10.13 Anger**, *What it does next* | The plot with gnashing teeth (Psa 37:12); rage that wants to kill at once, which is not a plan (Act 5:33–35) | Widened |

| **Ch 11 §4 One word, opposite values** | New faces: "Purposing" (*zāmam*: Psa 17:3; 37:12; Pro 31:16; Jer 4:28) and "Planning ahead" (Luk 14:31; Act 27:12; 2Ti 3:10; Joh 11:53; Pro 16:9). The reading of what changes them is marked "I read" | New faces |

In the scan I asked whether the "count, regard, esteem" verses belong with looking ahead. Your instruction counted all 77, so the 13 count verses are woven too. They went where reckoning already lives, in 10.4 *It reckons* (and 10.9 for Hos 8:12), not into *Planning*. This keeps the two apart, as the verses do.
